name: waves
description: CAT-1, CAT-4: a wave-height sensor is installed. Wave height is measured, ingested, monitored for drift, forecast and announced on its own topic, forecast/wave; the passage planner subscribes to it and verifies each value.

steps.caption: Power-on: the planner sees wave height in the catalogue and subscribes to forecast/wave and forecast/cur (NOW-CAST + WAVES).
A swell builds: wave height rises +5σ over 20 s.
Current rises with it, so the drift quorum (two inputs) is met.
The drift run's forecast carries the new wave height; the planner fetches just that measurement and verifies it.
